subject: CAIQ control inventory & evidence sourcing plan for Meditech
messages:
From: Lisa Chan <lisa.chan@meditech.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Meditech Security Team <security@meditech.com>
Date: 2027-06-23T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: CAIQ initial ask — inventory + evidence cadence

Hi David,

Thanks for the quick intro during Friday's call. As discussed, our security team needs a completed CAIQ matrix plus an evidence inventory mapped to each control by next Friday so we can finish our vendor review. Two asks: 1) a single spreadsheet with your CAIQ answers (control-by-control) and 2) a simple evidence index (artifact name, owner, path/link, and retention window).

We'd prefer an initial draft we can review by 6/25, then a finalized package on 6/30. Please include point contacts for any technical controls that will need traces or log extracts.

Attached is our standard intake template — feel free to fill directly.

Best,
Lisa Chan
Senior Information Security Manager | Meditech Health
lisa.chan@meditech.com

--- attachment: Meditech_CAIQ_intake_template.xlsx (xlsx) ---

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Lisa Chan <lisa.chan@meditech.com>
Date: 2027-06-23T10:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ initial ask — inventory + evidence cadence

Thanks Lisa — we can meet that timeline.

Internal note: Marissa/Karthik/Monica — heads-up: Meditech needs a CAIQ matrix + an evidence index with owners and links. Target: draft by 2027-06-25, final by 2027-06-30. Key constraints they called out: log traces for runtime isolation controls and contact for KMS/HSM attestations.

Proposed split of work:
- Marissa: lead control answers for Network, Cryptography, Identity (NIST/CSA crosswalk) and assemble CAIQ spreadsheet.
- Karthik: collect runtime and logging evidence — app logs, K8s audit, KV-caching traces; produce sample extracts for controls CCM-11, CCM-12.
- Monica: produce evidence index PDF listing artifacts, owners, retention, and storage paths. Also coordinate DocuSign for the attestation if needed.

Please add any blockers by EOD. I'll take point on the delivery to Meditech and handle any clarifications.

-David
David Kim
Security Partnerships | Redwood Inference
"redwood-support@redwood.ai"

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Lisa Chan <lisa.chan@meditech.com>
Date: 2027-06-24T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: CAIQ initial ask — inventory + evidence cadence

Quick status update and a couple of clarifying Qs for scope:

Status:
- I completed the answers for Network, Identity, and Cryptography sections and saved to the draft spreadsheet (attached). I used the CAIQ 4.0 control IDs and annotated where we rely on cloud provider security features vs Redwood-managed controls.
- Karthik sent a ZIP stub listing log extract examples for runtime controls — we'll pick two representative traces.
- Monica is drafting the evidence-index PDF with artifact owners.

Questions:
1) For controls that reference third-party cloud provider managed services (e.g., cloud KMS, VPC flow logs), do you want us to include provider artifacts (AWS Console screenshots / ARNs) or our internal config + audit logs? We can provide both but want to confirm what your reviewer prefers.
2) They requested retention windows — our `data_retention_policy.pdf` lists canonical windows, but operational buckets (prod vs non-prod) differ. Should we add a column that calls out prod/non-prod retention per artifact?

Plan for delivery:
- Draft CAIQ + evidence index (with links to a shared Drive folder) by 6/25 11:59am PT.
- After Meditech feedback, finalize on 6/30 and produce a single evidence bundle PDF.

Attachment: CAIQ_draft_Meditech_answers.xlsx

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Compliance Program Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Chan <lisa.chan@meditech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-24T14:21:00-07:00
Subject: Delivering draft CAIQ + evidence index (Meditech)

Hi Lisa — attaching our draft CAIQ answers and an evidence index PDF for your review. Highlights and notes up front:

- Draft contains control-by-control answers using CAIQ 4.0 IDs; columns flagged with "needs clarification" where control scope touches managed cloud provider artifacts.
- Evidence index maps each artifact to an owner and a Drive link. Where Meditech requested provider-side artifacts, we've included screenshots and ARN references in the Drive folder.
- Runtime/logging: Karthik included two representative log extracts (k8s-audit-sample.txt, runtime-auth-trace.txt) and a short README describing the extraction process.
- Retention windows: we added prod/non-prod columns plus a reference to our canonical policy (data_retention_policy.pdf).

Next steps: please review and call out any controls you want deeper traces for — we can provide additional log slices or schedule a short walkthrough with Karthik. If the draft looks good, we'll finalize and assemble a single evidence bundle (PDF) by 6/30.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2B3cRedwoodCAIQ
HubSpot: MT-0921

Attachments: CAIQ_template_Meditech_v1.xlsx, evidence-index-Redwood-2027-06.pdf

Thanks,
David Kim
Security Partnerships | Redwood Inference
"redwood-support@redwood.ai"
